notes.title: Content Update - 1.12.0
notes.content:
[h1]The Talking Drum[/h1]
Ardura's birthday turns upside down after the girls accidentally break her birthday present... a cursed glass relic that is the only thing holding back the snake god, Yeeg. Perhaps this is how Ardura wanted to spend her afternoon, hunting down and killing a god.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/25ce7a29943d3cbdd50dfdee9a460f55fc9a32e7.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added "The Talking Drum" main story quest
[*] Global "Fuck" button now has a cooldown of 0.2 seconds
[*] Esxea's "Gangbang" skill now has a cooldown of 0.2 seconds
[*] Ardura's "Choke" skill now costs 3.0 stamina instead of 2.0
[*] Ardura's "Choke" skill now has a cooldown of 1.0 seconds
[*] Ardura's "Choke" skill arousal multiplier reduced from 30% to 20%
[*] Natasha's "Zap" skill duration increased from 10 seconds to 20 seconds
[*] Natasha's "Zap" skill now costs 5.0 stamina instead of 3.0
[*] Natasha's "Zap" skill's cooldown increased to 3.33 seconds from 0.1
[*] Increased timer for first Morass boss battle
[/list]

Gameplay changes were made to prevent spam clicking during battles.

I have changed the formulas for the experience gain because the higher levels felt impossible to reach without crazy amounts of grinding. Also, I wanted the girls to feel slightly more powerful when you level up so I changed their stat gain a little bit.

I hope you guys enjoy Hounds of Love. It is a very funny quest!

notes.title: Content Update - 1.7.0
notes.content:
[h1]My Crazy Girlfriend[/h1]

Welcome to your first day at Easthollow University. Your parents told you to get good grades and stay out of trouble! Unfortunately for you, you sat next to Suki...

This quest is written in the first person point of view. The choices you make during the quest will effect how the story plays out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/aa3def13c3e0a1c2d8bcf3ecd85002bc62e53073.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/c9e5c990340a1ec8ad83833d0753c9001ae10b2b.png[/img]

[h1]Wolf Princess[/h1]

Greenhaven loses their alpha bitch, Thisa, right before a full moon. Alpha bitches are not easily replaceable, but Scarlett offers to keep the the dogs in line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/187f490dbf8068c6c72f9fc55c303419d937b544.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added "My Crazy Girlfriend" side quest
[*] Added "Wolf Princess" side quest
[*] Added Superior Orc outfit for Queen, Suki, Esxea, Scarlett and Natasha
[*] Fixed gold coin animation being paused in cheat menu
[*] Fixed an issue where variants would not load correctly when mods were enabled
[*] Changed cumshot animation video format to hopefully fix issues with black screens
[*] Fixed various issues with outfits
[*] Fixed typos
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update - 1.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]Natasha's Worst Enemy[/h1]

Arietta, after a grueling day, decides to pick on Natasha to relieve her stress. With Natasha's newfound confidence, she challenges Arietta to a duel! Arietta knows Natasha is way out of her league, but her ego won't stop the battle from happening. Natasha has plans on how to humiliate her in front of her peers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/9c3cf04a1ef23d59a70daef6b74cbc7ca13fb3bb.png[/img]

[h1]Tastes Like Candy[/h1]

The Easthollow humans have been plagued by a new infectious disease that is turning people's faces pink. Esxea, the super heroine, is the only person capable of saving the world. Atleast, that's what her other goblin friends told her. Strangely, everyone's face seems to be pink after leaving the brothel...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/a0bc49a7f5bf4aac16b3729e2ed4a3ced687276b.png[/img]

[h1]Skill Cast Bar[/h1]

A visual cast bar is now available for both player and enemy skills that last a period of time. Now you don't have to flip back and forth between characters to know if their skill is still active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/e9e4bc4f67cfc2e87cf0ebcfea8b494b70cf2d08.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added "Natasha's Worst Enemy" side quest
[*] Added "Tastes Like Candy" side quest
[*] Added visual cast bar for skills that last a long period of time
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update - 1.3.0
notes.content:
[h1]Lucifer Quest[/h1]

Suki wants her demon mom to come visit her in the human world, but Lucifer won't let Lilith leave. Suki takes this as a challenge to convince him. Unfortunately for the girls, the longer they stay in hell, the more demon-like they become.

This quest has a boss battle featuring a new enemy type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/0db505082b43fb089c206f7be2d426217a048303.png[/img]

[h1]Lilith Comes Home Quest[/h1]

Lilith comes to the human world to spend quality time with her daughter. Lilith has to suppress her desires to drain every man in the vicinity. Leaving Lilith alone for just a minute gave her an opportunity to suck the soul out of a poor defenseless man. How will the girls keep Lilith in line?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/1127b98e1376b9026e9c3367410fa37bd38a8ade.png[/img]

We are pleased to introduce new members to our team. Queen's Brothel is a game that deserves many sexy quests to play through. To achieve this, we need help. We have hired new writers and artists onto the team.

Writer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/cc1021fceb667bf875c077f7f9e44747f9930ca9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/01ec8c78d2a7d4a22f59896c8a18e42cfcba0b58.png[/img]

notes.title: Content Update - 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h1]Stuck in the Stables[/h1]
==========================

Scarlett takes Queen horseback riding, but her childhood horse Willow has gone missing! Scarlett storms off to tell her dad, leaving Queen alone in the stables. As she waits, Queen accidentally gets stuck in a horse stock and is unable to pull herself out due to her incredibly voluptuous body!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/8d224c2295b0698f8e19d1e68528ab67fb8a25de.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Outfits[/h2]

[i]Stuck in the Stables[/i] brings two new outfits into the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/899588f64f610f6bd6567e093459d9ece1ca0bd8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Suki the Boy Toy[/h1]
======================

Suki takes Natasha's futanari potions to class. She taunts the boys by jerking off her penis in-class. Enjoying her time tormenting the boys, she accidentally gets caught by her professor. Suki's enjoyment of tormenting people comes to an end when she realizes that her professor likes her penis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/976ff9088775693e55e2059db4c57800a3440bde.jpg[/img]

[h1]Outfit Randomizer[/h1]
=================

We have added a toggle in the outfits menu to have the girls change their clothes into a random outfit everytime they sleep!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/32af3b440d9745245fbb03dd24268375755f5f0e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
===========

-   Added "Stuck in the Stables" side quest
-   Added "Suki the Boy Toy" side quest
-   Added random daily outfit toggle in the outfits menu
-   Improved loading speed when opening outfits menu
-   You can now use "Space" or "Ctrl" to close images during dialogue instead of having to click
-   Fixed typos
